title: 18361 - 18361/P1953/006483
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Turbo Charger Control Module 2 faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Turbo Charger Control Module 2
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Turbo Charger Control Module 2
technicalNotes: When found in VW Touareg (7L) OR VW Phaeton (3D) with V10 TDI (AJS, AYH, BLE, BWF), check Turbo Charger Linkage and Linkage Seal for Damage. If no Damage is found replace Turbo Charger as described in TPI 2009705.
